content:
To verify Ohm's law, a student connects the voltmeter across the battery as, shown in the figure. The measured voltage is plotted as a function of the current, and the following graph is obtained :
If V0 is almost zero, identify the correct statement :

options.content: The value of the resistance R is 1.5 <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.633ex" height="1.593ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -704 722 704" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="3A9" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-3A9"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>

The emf of the battery is l.5 V and its internal resistance is 1.5 <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.633ex" height="1.593ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -704 722 704" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="3A9" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-3A9"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>

The emf of the battery is l.5 V and the value of R is 1.5 <mjx-container class="MathJax" jax="SVG" overflow="overflow"><svg style="vertical-align: 0;" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1.633ex" height="1.593ex" role="img" focusable="false" viewBox="0 -704 722 704" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink"><g stroke="currentColor" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="0" transform="scale(1,-1)"><g data-mml-node="math"><g data-mml-node="mi"><use data-c="3A9" xlink:href="#MJX-TEX-N-3A9"></use></g></g></g></svg></mjx-container>
The potential difference across the battery is 1.5 V when it sends a current of 1000 mA

explanation:
V = E – Ir

When V = V0 = 0 0 = E – Ir

E = r

When I = 0, V = E = 1.5 V

r = 1.5
